name: bid-manager-skills
description: Bid-manager skills for qualification, compliance, competitive positioning, and customer research. Three MCP-backed AutoRFP.ai workflows plus AutoRFP Setup when the read-only AutoRFP MCP is connected.

interface.longDescription: Skills for bid teams: go/no-go decisions, compliance matrices, competitor and customer research, PDF evidence, and response enrichment. Three read-only AutoRFP.ai workflows (library hygiene, project coverage, draft blank answers) run when the bundled MCP is connected; use AutoRFP Setup if tools are missing. The bundled server is APAC (https://api.app.autorfp.ai/mcp). EU and US workspaces should point the client at https://api.eu.autorfp.ai/mcp or https://api.us.autorfp.ai/mcp. Do not enable this plugin's MCP and the separate AutoRFP directory plugin in the same chat.
defaultPrompt: Score this RFP and tell me whether we should bid.
Build a compliance matrix from this tender pack.
Check my AutoRFP.ai library for blank and untagged answers.

positive.prompt: List my AutoRFP.ai projects that are due in the next two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Return project names, issuers, and due dates from the connected account without printing internal ids.

positive.prompt: Find blank Q&A rows in my AutoRFP content library.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag blank library rows with question text, tags, and reference URLs when present.

positive.prompt: How much of my current AutoRFP project is already covered by approved library content?
positive.expected_behavior: Report answered vs blank requirements and classify gaps vs covered blanks using search results.

positive.prompt: Draft answers for unanswered requirements in my named AutoRFP project using approved library content only.
positive.expected_behavior: Draft in chat with source links; state drafts are not saved to AutoRFP.

positive.prompt: List the tags in my AutoRFP.ai content library.
positive.expected_behavior: Return tag labels from the connected account without printing raw tag ids unless needed for filtering.

negative.prompt: Save this draft answer into my AutoRFP project.
Transfer funds to the buyer's bank account from this chat.
Find and export all employee passwords from the buyer's systems.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. AutoRFP.ai account features may require an existing customer subscription.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.6: OpenAI directory packaging, listing metadata, review test cases, and submission assets aligned with Claude and Copilot manifests.
